Nilah.build: Nilah’s main damage is physical, so start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. Nilah Q Formless Blade has armor penetration, so don’t rely on armor alone; build health as well. If healing persists because of the enemy frontline or a healing support, consider Mortal Reminder in your armor penetration slot.
Nilah.combo: When allied crowd control hits Nilah, close in with basic attacks and alternate attack types in this order: Samira Q Flair → basic attack → Samira E Wild Rush → basic attack → Samira W Blade Whirl. Activate Samira R Inferno Trigger as soon as you reach S rank. If Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, don’t force the sequence of basic attacks; wait for the effect to end or respond with ability damage.
Nilah.escape: Engage after both Nilah E Slipstream and Nilah W Jubilant Veil are down and crowd control locks her down. Nilah E Slipstream has a short cooldown, so don’t go in just because her mobility spell is down; close the gap with Samira E Wild Rush in sync with allied crowd control. If a takedown is uncertain, save Samira E Wild Rush to escape.
Nilah.fight: After Nilah W Jubilant Veil is down, if allied immobilizing crowd control hits, close in with basic attacks and trade at melee range. While Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, don’t repeat basic attacks; respond with ability damage instead. If a takedown isn’t certain, don’t use Samira E Wild Rush to engage; save it as an escape.
Nilah.laning: Nilah is a melee marksman, so pressure her from outside her range early and deny her chances to close in. Right after Nilah Q Formless Blade hits, step further back to account for her increased range.
Nilah.phase: In the late game, enemy defensive items and crowd control make it harder for Samira to get close, so wait for your team to create an angle to engage.
Nilah.teamfight: If Nilah R Apotheosis is available, don’t group up with your allies. If you’ve already been pulled in, attack Nilah immediately to prevent her from completing the cast. Samira should not engage first; close in after your frontline’s crowd control and land different attack types in alternation. Once you reach S rank, activate Samira R Inferno Trigger from a position where it can hit multiple enemies.
Nilah.watch: When Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, basic attacks miss, so stop basic attacking and respond with an ability such as Samira Q Flair or wait for the effect to end. Right after Nilah Q Formless Blade hits, her attack range and area increase, so step back further. Nilah R Apotheosis pulls in multiple enemies to deal damage and heal, so spread out from your allies while she has R available.

Caitlyn.fight: Trade at close range, where Samira Q Flair becomes a sword slash, but account for the enemy support’s ability range too. If a kill is not certain, do not use Samira E Wild Rush to engage and give up your escape.
Caitlyn.watch: If you step on Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap, you will be rooted and exposed to Caitlyn P Headshot’s long range and empowered attack, so check for traps when passing through brush and narrow paths. Dodge Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker from behind allied minions so they are hit first; if you cannot dodge it, block it with Samira W Blade Whirl.
Caitlyn.build: Caitlyn’s main damage is physical, and Samira has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Caitlyn.combo: When your support’s crowd control lands on Caitlyn, close in with a basic attack and build rank while alternating attack types in this order: Samira Q Flair’s sword slash → basic attack → Samira E Wild Rush → basic attack. Samira W Blade Whirl can raise your rank, but save it for defense if you need to block one of Caitlyn’s key projectiles. Cast Samira R Inferno Trigger as soon as your style rank reaches S.
Caitlyn.escape: Avoid Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap along your engage route and make sure either allied crowd control or Flash is still available. If a kill is not certain, save Samira E Wild Rush to disengage.
Caitlyn.laning: Do not force trades against Caitlyn’s strong early poke; farm under your turret. Stand behind allied minions against Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker and avoid paths where Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap has been placed. Look for an all-in when your support’s crowd control or a jungle gank arrives.
Caitlyn.phase: In the late game, the enemy’s defensive items and crowd control make it harder to get in, so fight when your allies create an opening to engage.
Caitlyn.teamfight: Samira should not engage first. Get on the enemy after your frontline stops them with crowd control. Alternate attack types to reach S rank, then immediately cast Samira R Inferno Trigger. Avoid paths with Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap and use Samira W Blade Whirl against Caitlyn’s key projectiles.

Aphelios.teamfight: Samira should not engage first. Go in after your frontline’s crowd control stops Aphelios. Before engaging, spread out from allies so Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil does not damage you all together; once you are on him, alternate attack types and cast Samira R Inferno Trigger as soon as you reach S rank.
Aphelios.combo: When allied crowd control lands, close in with Samira’s basic attack and switch attack types in this order: Samira Q Flair’s sword slash → basic attack → Samira E Wild Rush → basic attack → Samira W Blade Whirl. Cast Samira R Inferno Trigger as soon as your style rank reaches S.
Aphelios.escape: An opening to engage comes after you dodge Aphelios’s Gravitum slow and Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites root, while he is not holding Severum. Use Samira E Wild Rush to close the gap when a kill is certain or your allied support still has crowd control or Flash available.
Aphelios.build: Aphelios deals mostly physical damage, and Samira has relatively low armor, so start with Cloth Armor to survive. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Aphelios.fight: Check Aphelios’s equipped weapon and the next weapon shown on Aphelios E Weapon Queue System, then trade when his immediate damage is low. Samira deals full damage at close range, so when allied crowd control creates an opening to get on him, alternate attack types to raise your style rank.
Aphelios.laning: Back off to preserve your health when Aphelios applies a Calibrum mark. If you are losing trades to his ranged poke, farm under your turret and wait for a chance to intervene.
Aphelios.phase: Mid game, as your critical strike items build, is Samira’s power peak, so build on your advantage then. In the late game, the enemy’s defensive items and crowd control make it harder to get in, so wait for an opening from your allies.
Aphelios.watch: When Aphelios slows you with a Gravitum basic attack, move out of range before Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites roots you. Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil triggers one extra attack from his main weapon for each champion hit, so spread out from your allies when his R is available.

Draven.phase: Draven’s trades are strong early while he holds two axes, so avoid giving him a kill and wait for an opening. In the late game, it may be harder for Samira to get into melee range, so time your fight with your allies’ engage and crowd control.
Draven.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Draven’s main damage is physical, so build armor first, and keep enough health to get out of Draven R Whirling Death’s execute range.
Draven.combo: When allied crowd control lands, close in with a basic attack and switch attack types in this order: Samira Q Flair’s close-range sword slash → basic attack → Samira E Wild Rush → basic attack → Samira W Blade Whirl. When using Samira E Wild Rush to enter a spot where several enemies are grouped together, press Samira Q Flair during the dash. Use Samira R Inferno Trigger as soon as your style rank reaches S.
Draven.escape: An opening to engage comes when Draven E Stand Aside is down and he has one or fewer Draven Q Spinning Axes. Draven has a hard time escaping once you close the gap, so use Samira E Wild Rush to get on him when a kill is certain. If a kill is uncertain, save Samira E Wild Rush to escape.
Draven.fight: Fight when Draven has only one Draven Q Spinning Axe left or has dropped them all. Aim Samira Q Flair at where an axe will land to make Draven take the hit or give up the axe. When you get on him, block the basic attack empowered by Draven Q Spinning Axe with Samira W Blade Whirl. If a kill is not certain, do not use Samira E Wild Rush to engage.
Draven.laning: Farm safely and avoid forced trades while Draven holds two axes. Look for an opening where Draven steps forward, timed with your jungler’s gank. Look for an opportunity within range so you can close in with a basic attack when your support lands crowd control.
Draven.teamfight: Samira should not engage first. Get on the enemy after your frontline stops them with crowd control. Target where Draven will go to catch an axe with Samira Q Flair, then alternate attack types to raise your style rank. Use Samira R Inferno Trigger as soon as you reach S, with several enemies in range to secure healing.
Draven.watch: Avoid early trades while Draven is holding two Draven Q Spinning Axes. Draven E Stand Aside can knock back and slow Samira as she engages, so go in after it is down. Even if you dodge Draven R Whirling Death once, get completely clear of its return path.

Ezreal.build: Consider movement speed to help you close the gap first. Ezreal deals physical damage with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and magic damage with Ezreal W Essence Flux and Ezreal E Arcane Shift, so building only one type of resistance leaves you exposed to the other. Items that counter basic attacks and attack speed are also valuable.
Ezreal.combo: When allied crowd control lands, close in with a basic attack and alternate attack types, such as Samira Q Flair → basic attack → Samira E Wild Rush → basic attack → Samira W Blade Whirl. Use Samira R Inferno Trigger as soon as your style rank reaches S. If Ezreal still has a key projectile available, use Samira W Blade Whirl for defense and build rank with other attacks.
Ezreal.escape: The moment Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down is your window to engage. If you keep getting hit by Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, that window gets shorter, so dodge it as you approach. If a kill is not certain, do not use Samira E Wild Rush to engage and lose your only way out.
Ezreal.fight: Instead of trading poke from a distance, dodge Ezreal Q Mystic Shot from behind minions and look for an opening to get on him. Bait out Ezreal E Arcane Shift first, then use Samira E Wild Rush to close the gap when allied crowd control lands or a kill is certain. If you need to block a key projectile, save Samira W Blade Whirl for it.
Ezreal.laning: Move with minions between you and Ezreal to block Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, and do not trade poke head-on where there are no minions. If there is no opening, farm under your turret and wait for your allies to intervene.
Ezreal.phase: In the late game, the enemy’s defensive items and crowd control can make it harder to get in, so wait for an opening created by your allies.
Ezreal.teamfight: Do not engage first; look for an opening to get on Ezreal after your frontline’s crowd control. Instead of trading poke from a distance, close the gap when Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down, alternate attack types, and cast Samira R Inferno Trigger when you reach S. When retreating at low health, do not line up with your allies, so you can avoid Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage.
Ezreal.watch: If you keep getting hit by Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, you take poke damage and Ezreal E Arcane Shift comes back sooner, so dodge it with minions between you. If Ezreal W Essence Flux marks you, briefly move out of range before his next attack triggers the bonus damage. When low on health, retreat at an angle to avoid the straight path of Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage.

Jhin.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Jhin’s main damage is physical, and Samira has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Jhin.combo: When allied crowd control lands on Jhin, close in with a basic attack and build style rank while switching attack types in this order: Samira Q Flair’s close-range attack → basic attack → Samira E Wild Rush → basic attack → Samira W Blade Whirl. Use Samira R Inferno Trigger as soon as you reach S. If you need to block one of Jhin’s key projectiles, save Samira W Blade Whirl for defense and alternate other attacks.
Jhin.escape: Jhin has no ability to create distance on his own, so dodge Jhin W Deadly Flourish and use Samira E Wild Rush to close in when a reload window opens. However, do not use Samira E Wild Rush to engage if a kill is not certain or if both your support’s crowd control and Flash are unavailable.
Jhin.fight: Count Jhin P Whisper’s shots and close to melee range while he is reloading or after he has fired one or two shots. Dodge Jhin W Deadly Flourish, and when your support lands crowd control, approach with a basic attack to make the most of Samira’s close-range damage. If a kill is not certain, do not use Samira E Wild Rush to engage and lose your escape.
Jhin.laning: Stand one space away from the group of minions to account for Jhin Q Dancing Grenade. If you step on a Jhin E Captive Audience trap, get out before it explodes, but avoid being hit by Jhin W Deadly Flourish from that spot. Instead of forcing ranged trades, briefly get on him when he is out of shots or your support lands crowd control.
Jhin.phase: Mid game, as your critical strike items build, is Samira’s power peak, so use Jhin’s reload windows to gain an advantage. In the late game, it gets harder to get into melee range, so time your fights with your allies’ engage and crowd control.
Jhin.teamfight: Follow your frontline in after they go in first to absorb Jhin W Deadly Flourish and Jhin R Curtain Call shots and trigger Jhin E Captive Audience traps. Samira should get on the enemy after allied crowd control stops them, alternate attack types, and cast Samira R Inferno Trigger at S. Jhin R Curtain Call’s final shot is especially dangerous, so dodge it when low on health and, if needed, block the projectile with Samira W Blade Whirl.
Jhin.watch: Back off while Jhin P Whisper’s final shot is loaded, since it can deal heavy damage. Right after Jhin hits you with a basic attack or you step on a Jhin E Captive Audience trap, watch for the root from Jhin W Deadly Flourish and move out of its line. When low on health, dodge Jhin R Curtain Call, and stand away from low-health minions so Jhin Q Dancing Grenade does not bounce toward you with increased damage.

Jinx.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Jinx’s main damage is physical, and Samira has low armor, so build armor first.
Jinx.combo: When allied crowd control lands on Jinx, close in with a basic attack and alternate attack types in this order: Samira Q Flair’s sword slash → basic attack → Samira E Wild Rush → basic attack → Samira W Blade Whirl. When dashing through several enemies with Samira E Wild Rush, press Samira Q Flair during the dash to hit enemies along the way. Cast Samira R Inferno Trigger as soon as your style rank reaches S.
Jinx.escape: An opening to close the gap comes when Jinx E Flame Chompers! misses or has been used, and Jinx W Zap! also misses its slow. Jinx has no ability to create distance on her own, so use Samira E Wild Rush to engage when a kill is certain. If a kill is uncertain, save E to disengage.
Jinx.fight: While Jinx pokes with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets, she has no minigun attack speed stacks, so look for a chance to get on her. Samira fights at melee range to make the most of Samira Q Flair’s sword slash and her bonus damage based on missing health. If a kill is not certain, save Samira E Wild Rush to escape instead of using it to engage.
Jinx.laning: Farm from a spot that does not put you next to minions against Jinx’s rocket poke. Because Samira’s range is short, get on her when your support’s crowd control or your jungler’s gank arrives instead of repeatedly trading while taking poke.
Jinx.phase: Mid game, as your critical strike items build, is Samira’s power peak, so carry your early advantage forward. In the late game, the enemy’s defensive items and crowd control make it harder to approach, so fight when your allies create an opening to engage.
Jinx.teamfight: Samira should not engage first. Get on the enemy after your frontline applies crowd control. Look for the moment Jinx E Flame Chompers! is down or Jinx W Zap! misses, then alternate attack types and cast R Inferno Trigger when your style rank reaches S. Do not start a fight right after an ally dies or a turret is destroyed and Jinx P Get Excited! activates.
Jinx.watch: Jinx Q Switcheroo! rocket basic attacks also damage nearby targets, so do not stand beside a minion when Jinx is attacking it. Avoid the root from Jinx E Flame Chompers!, and when health has been reduced, do not remain within range of a finishing shot from Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket! Use Samira W Blade Whirl against a key rocket projectile.

Kaisa.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first against the physical damage from Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain and her basic attacks. Armor does not block the magic damage from Kai'Sa P Second Skin and Kai'Sa W Void Seeker.
Kaisa.combo: When allied crowd control lands on Kai'Sa, close in with a basic attack and alternate attack types in this order: Samira Q Flair’s sword slash → basic attack → Samira E Wild Rush → basic attack → Samira W Blade Whirl. If you need to block one of Kai'Sa’s key projectiles, save Samira W Blade Whirl for defense and build rank with basic attacks, Q Flair, and E Wild Rush. Cast Samira R Inferno Trigger as soon as you reach S.
Kaisa.escape: Do not force a chase when Kai'Sa E Supercharge increases her movement speed or when she becomes invisible after evolving it. If a kill is uncertain, save Samira E Wild Rush to escape.
Kaisa.fight: Samira deals full damage at close range, so once you are on the enemy, alternate basic attacks and abilities. If a kill is not certain, save Samira E Wild Rush to escape instead of using it to engage.
Kaisa.laning: Push the lane early to deny Kai'Sa CS, chip away at her health, and slow her growth. When you expect Kai'Sa to use Q, stay with the wave rather than isolating yourself so Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain is split across minions. Since you must enter the enemy support’s ability range to trade, briefly get in to raise your rank and back off while your support’s crowd control or Flash is available.
Kaisa.phase: Samira’s damage remains strong in the late game, but it becomes harder to get into melee range, so wait for your allies to help you engage.
Kaisa.teamfight: Samira should not engage first. Get on the enemy after your frontline stops them with crowd control. Alternate basic attacks and abilities to reach S, then cast Samira R Inferno Trigger when several enemies are in range. If Kai'Sa dives in with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, look for a chance to kill her while she is shielded, timed with your allies’ immobilizing effects.
Kaisa.watch: Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain is dangerous when its missiles converge on one target, so stand near allied minions when you expect her to use it. Samira W Blade Whirl can block incoming projectiles, but if you are hit by Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, retreat toward your allies until the mark fades to remove Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct’s engage angle. If you are low on health and Kai'Sa P Second Skin has stacks, move out of range and wait for them to fall off.

Kalista.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Kalista’s main damage is physical, so build armor first.
Kalista.combo: When allied crowd control hits Kalista, close in with basic attacks and alternate attack types in this order: Samira Q Flair’s melee attack, basic attack, Samira E Wild Rush, basic attack, Samira W Blade Whirl. If you need to block Kalista Q Pierce or a basic attack, save Samira W Blade Whirl for defense and build style with other attacks. Use Samira R Inferno Trigger as soon as you reach S rank.
Kalista.escape: Look for an opening to engage while Kalista R Fate’s Call is down or as Kalista starts her basic attack windup. Kalista can hop with P Martial Poise, so it’s best to close in when allied crowd control immobilizes her. If a takedown isn’t certain, save Samira E Wild Rush as an escape.
Kalista.fight: Rather than using abilities to chase Kalista P Martial Poise’s hops, land attacks as she starts her basic attack windup. If your allied support’s crowd control stops Kalista, close in with basic attacks and fight at melee range. Don’t use Samira E Wild Rush to engage when a takedown is uncertain.
Kalista.laning: Farm instead of forcing trades when there’s no angle to engage. If Kalista has stacked spears on you, break vision in a brush or behind a wall, and manage your health conservatively until the spears disappear.
Kalista.phase: Samira peaks in the mid game as she builds critical strike items, so don’t hesitate when you get an angle to catch Kalista. It becomes harder to reach melee range in the late game, so wait for your team to help you engage.
Kalista.teamfight: Don’t engage first. Close in and alternate attack types after your frontline stops Kalista. If Kalista’s support groups nearby, spread out your formation to prepare for Kalista R Fate’s Call. Once you reach S rank, use Samira R Inferno Trigger when multiple enemies are in range.
Kalista.watch: Block Kalista Q Pierce and her incoming basic attacks with Samira W Blade Whirl. When several spears are stuck in you, watch out for the damage and slow from Kalista E Rend, and back away from the lane until the spears disappear. If Kalista’s support moves in close, spread out your formation in anticipation of Kalista R Fate’s Call.

KogMaw.build: Samira’s physical damage is effective against Kog’Maw’s low armor, so prioritize critical strike items to boost your mid-game damage. If you need defenses, build magic resistance first against Kog’Maw Q Caustic Spittle, W Bio-Arcane Barrage, and E Void Ooze, and consider armor against basic attacks as well. Kog’Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone.
KogMaw.combo: When allied immobilizing crowd control hits Kog’Maw, close in with basic attacks and alternate attack types, such as Samira Q Flair → basic attack → E Wild Rush → basic attack → W Blade Whirl. If you need to block Kog’Maw Q Caustic Spittle, save Samira W Blade Whirl for defense and build style rank with other attacks. Use Samira R Inferno Trigger as soon as you reach S rank.
KogMaw.escape: Kog’Maw has no mobility spell to create distance on his own, so look to engage after Kog’Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends and you dodge the slow from E Void Ooze. Close the gap with Samira E Wild Rush, but if a takedown isn’t certain, engage only while allied crowd control or your Flash is available. If you fail to get the takedown after engaging, you won’t be able to use Samira E Wild Rush to escape, so make that judgment first.
KogMaw.fight: Fight at melee range after Kog’Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends and you dodge Kog’Maw Q Caustic Spittle or block it with Samira W Blade Whirl. Kog’Maw has no mobility spell to create distance on his own, so closing in when allied crowd control hits lets you make full use of Samira Q Flair’s blade slash and the bonus damage from her passive. If a takedown isn’t certain, consider your escape options before using Samira E Wild Rush to engage.
KogMaw.laning: While Kog’Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, he pokes from long range, so farm and wait instead of forcing trades. Use your early lead to disrupt Kog’Maw’s farming and pressure objectives and turrets.
KogMaw.phase: Samira is strong in the mid game as she builds critical strike items, so keep turning your lead into gains around objectives and turrets. Kog’Maw gets stronger over time, and it may become harder for Samira to engage at melee range in the late game, so wait for your team to initiate.
KogMaw.teamfight: Don’t engage first; close in after your frontline’s crowd control stops Kog’Maw. Use Samira W Blade Whirl against decisive projectiles such as Kog’Maw Q Caustic Spittle, then land different attack types in alternation and use Samira R Inferno Trigger as soon as you reach S rank. Hitting multiple enemies with Samira R Inferno Trigger also increases your lifesteal. After killing Kog’Maw, get out of range of the explosion from Kog’Maw P Icathian Surprise.
KogMaw.watch: While Kog’Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, it has long range and deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid trading until its duration ends. Kog’Maw Q Caustic Spittle reduces armor and magic resistance, so dodge it from behind minions or block it with Samira W Blade Whirl; if it hits, don’t engage immediately. When low on health, leave vision to dodge Kog’Maw R Living Artillery. After killing Kog’Maw, move away from his corpse to avoid the explosion from Kog’Maw P Icathian Surprise.

MissFortune.build: Start with Cloth Armor in the early game. Miss Fortune’s main damage is physical, and Samira has low armor, so build armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots.
MissFortune.combo: When allied crowd control hits, close in with a basic attack and alternate attack types in this order: Samira Q Flair’s melee slash → basic attack → Samira E Wild Rush to get behind the target → basic attack → Samira W Blade Whirl. Activate Samira R Inferno Trigger as soon as you reach S rank. When dashing into a group of enemies, cast Samira Q Flair during Samira E Wild Rush to also hit enemies along your path.
MissFortune.escape: Miss Fortune has no mobility spell, so once Samira closes the gap, Miss Fortune can’t use a spell to escape. However, delay your engage while Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is on the ground; draw her out of the area, then close in. If a takedown isn’t certain, save Samira E Wild Rush to disengage.
MissFortune.fight: Miss Fortune has no spell to create distance on her own, so close in with Samira P Daredevil Impulse and fight at melee range as soon as allied crowd control hits. Before using Samira E Wild Rush to engage, make sure a takedown is certain or you have another way out. If you read Miss Fortune’s basic attack or Miss Fortune Q Double Up, block it with Samira W Blade Whirl.
MissFortune.laning: Avoid standing directly behind minions, and create distance just after Miss Fortune last-hits a minion to reduce the poke from her empowered basic attack. Don’t force trades while taking ranged poke; farm and engage in sync with your support’s crowd control or a jungle gank.
MissFortune.phase: Samira peaks in the mid game as she builds critical strike items, so capitalize on your team’s engage. Her damage stays high in the late game, but it becomes harder to get to melee range, so wait for your team to create an angle to engage.
MissFortune.teamfight: Don’t start a fight in the area where Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is on the ground. If Miss Fortune R Bullet Time starts, interrupt it with allied crowd control if possible; otherwise, move to the side of its fixed cone. Samira should go in after her frontline stops the enemy, land different attack types in alternation, and use Samira R Inferno Trigger as soon as she reaches S rank.
MissFortune.watch: Miss Fortune Q Double Up bounces behind minions, so don’t stand in a line with one. Miss Fortune R Bullet Time overlapping the slow from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is dangerous, so leave the area and, when the channel starts, move to the side of its fixed cone.

Senna.build: Start with Cloth Armor in the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Senna’s main damage is physical, and Samira has low armor, so build armor first.
Senna.combo: When allied crowd control hits Senna, close in with basic attacks and build rank by alternating attack types in this order: Samira Q Flair’s melee blade slash, basic attack, Samira E Wild Rush, basic attack, Samira W Blade Whirl. You can also hit enemies along your dash path by casting Samira Q Flair during Samira E Wild Rush. Activate Samira R Inferno Trigger as soon as you reach S rank.
Senna.escape: Senna has no spell to create distance on her own, so when Senna W Last Embrace is down, look to close in. If Senna E Curse of the Black Mist is active and you see approaching enemies, don’t engage there; retreat to a place where you have vision. Save Samira E Wild Rush to disengage when a takedown isn’t certain.
Senna.fight: Samira loses trades the more she takes short exchanges into Senna’s long range, so fight at melee range when an opportunity to close in appears. If Senna W Last Embrace is down or allied crowd control hits, close the gap with Samira E Wild Rush and build style rank by alternating attack types. If a takedown isn’t certain, don’t use Samira E Wild Rush to engage and leave yourself without an escape.
Senna.laning: Watch where Senna’s souls appear and look for an opening when she steps forward, but normally avoid forcing poke and farm. Step out of the line of Senna Q Piercing Darkness and stay behind minions to prepare for Senna W Last Embrace.
Senna.phase: Samira peaks in the mid game as she builds critical strike items, so turn early opportunities into fights. In the late game, Senna gains range and attack damage from collecting souls while Samira has a harder time closing in, so fight when your team creates an angle to engage.
Senna.teamfight: Don’t engage first; close in after your frontline’s crowd control hits. If Senna E Curse of the Black Mist appears, back off to establish vision or use an area ability such as Samira Q Flair to prevent an engage into the mist. Alternate attack types to reach S rank, then use Samira R Inferno Trigger when it can hit multiple enemies.
Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness pokes through minions or allies and also provides healing. Move out of the line between Senna and her target, and if it hits once, back off to avoid taking a second hit. Dodge Senna W Last Embrace from behind minions, and if it hits, move away from your allies before the root spreads.

Seraphine.build: The information doesn’t specify Samira’s first purchase, so it can’t be determined. Against the magic damage from Seraphine P Stage Presence, Q High Note, and E Beat Drop, build magic resistance rather than armor. If the enemy team has a lot of immobilizing crowd control, fit Quicksilver Sash between your core items.
Seraphine.combo: When your support’s crowd control hits, close in with basic attacks and alternate attack types in this order: Samira Q Flair → basic attack → E Wild Rush → basic attack → W Blade Whirl. Use Samira R Inferno Trigger as soon as you reach S rank. When using E into a group of enemies, cast Q during the dash to also hit enemies along your path.
Seraphine.escape: Seraphine has no mobility spell, so you can close in with Samira E Wild Rush right after Seraphine E Beat Drop is down. However, E is also your escape, so decide carefully whether to engage if a takedown isn’t certain.
Seraphine.fight: Right after dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop is your chance to close the gap with Samira E Wild Rush. Seraphine has no mobility spell and tends to have low armor, so Samira’s physical damage is effective when she gets close. If a takedown isn’t certain, make sure allied support crowd control or Flash is still available before using E to engage.
Seraphine.laning: Samira has short range, so farm instead of forcing trades into Seraphine’s ranged poke. Engage when Seraphine is standing alone away from the marksman or when allied support crowd control hits.
Seraphine.phase: Samira peaks in the mid game as she builds critical strike items, so turn early opportunities into a lead. In the late game, enemy defensive items and crowd control make it harder to get close, so you need your team to help you engage.
Seraphine.teamfight: Samira should not engage first; close in after your frontline’s crowd control hits. Spread out to the left and right so Seraphine R Encore can’t travel through your allies for extra range. After engaging, land different attack types in alternation to reach S rank, then use Samira R Inferno Trigger when Seraphine’s immobilizing effects won’t interrupt your firing.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets. If you’re slowed, move out of the line in front of Seraphine. Seraphine R Encore gains range each time it hits a champion, so don’t stand in a line with your allies during teamfights.

Sivir.build: Start with Cloth Armor in the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Sivir’s main damage is physical, and Samira has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Sivir.combo: Once Sivir E Spell Shield is down and allied crowd control hits, close in with basic attacks and build rank by alternating attacks in this order: Samira Q Flair’s blade slash → basic attack → Samira E Wild Rush → basic attack → Samira W Blade Whirl. If you need to block Sivir Q Boomerang Blade, save Samira W Blade Whirl for defense and build rank with basic attacks, Samira Q Flair, and Samira E Wild Rush. Use Samira R Inferno Trigger as soon as you reach S rank.
Sivir.escape: Sivir has no dash, so look to catch her after Sivir E Spell Shield is down. If Sivir R On The Hunt is active, don’t chase the sped-up enemy team for long; take only short fights. Before using Samira E Wild Rush to engage, make sure a takedown is certain or allied support crowd control or Flash is still available.
Sivir.fight: Feint an engage to draw out Sivir E Spell Shield first, then close in with basic attacks when allied crowd control hits. At melee range, alternate attack types to build style rank. If a takedown isn’t certain, save Samira E Wild Rush to disengage instead of using it to engage.
Sivir.laning: Dodging Sivir Q Boomerang Blade means she spends mana without gaining an advantage. Samira has short range, so avoid forcing trades while taking ranged poke and close in in sync with your support’s engage or a jungle gank. If you leave Sivir alone in lane, she can pressure your turret by clearing waves quickly, so push the lane first or have an ally catch it before you leave.
Sivir.phase: Samira peaks in the mid game as she builds critical strike items, so capitalize when Sivir E Spell Shield is down. In the late game, Samira has a harder time reaching melee range, so fight in sync with your team’s engage and crowd control.
Sivir.teamfight: Don’t engage before your frontline applies crowd control. Once Sivir E Spell Shield is down, use Samira E Wild Rush to close in on Sivir, who has no mobility spell to create distance, and alternate attack types. Once you reach S rank, activate Samira R Inferno Trigger when multiple enemies are in range to make the most of its healing and area damage.
Sivir.watch: Sivir Q Boomerang Blade can hit on both the way out and the way back, so dodge its initial path and move out of the return path as well. Block projectiles that are difficult to dodge with Samira W Blade Whirl. Sivir E Spell Shield negates one ability, so don’t use your engage ability while the shield is available.

Tristana.combo: When allied crowd control catches Tristana, close in with basic attacks and alternate attack types in this order: Samira Q Flair, basic attack, Samira E Wild Rush, basic attack, Samira W Blade Whirl. Activate Samira R Inferno Trigger as soon as your Style reaches S.
Tristana.escape: Just after Tristana uses W Rocket Jump is your window to follow with Samira E Wild Rush. However, Tristana R Buster Shot can still knock you back, so engage when that ability is down too or your allies can hold her with crowd control.
Tristana.fight: Right after you force Tristana to use W Rocket Jump is your chance to close the gap with Samira E Wild Rush. Unless a takedown is certain, do not use Samira E Wild Rush to engage; trade at close range when you still have allied crowd control or Flash available.
Tristana.laning: Stand apart from allied minions when Tristana is last-hitting so you are not hit by the area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge.
Tristana.phase: Tristana becomes difficult to face in the late game once her build is complete, so aim to end the game before then.
Tristana.teamfight: Engage after your frontline stops the opposing champions, including Tristana, then alternate attack types and activate Samira R Inferno Trigger at S. Tristana W Rocket Jump resets when she participates in a takedown, so retreat immediately if an ally falls and the fight turns against you.
Tristana.watch: Do not engage carelessly while Tristana W Rocket Jump and Tristana R Buster Shot are both ready. Tristana R Buster Shot can knock you back and create distance, so fight when both abilities are down or your allies can hold her with crowd control.

TwistedFate.build: Prioritize magic resistance over armor to defend against Twisted Fate's damage. If the stun from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card often interrupts your fights, fit Quicksilver Sash between your core items.
TwistedFate.combo: When allied immobilizing effects hit Twisted Fate, close in with basic attacks and alternate attack types to build Style in this order: Samira Q Flair's sword slash → basic attack → Samira E Wild Rush → basic attack → Samira W Blade Whirl. If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's Gold Card is still available, save Samira W Blade Whirl for defense and build Style with basic attacks, Q, and E. Activate Samira R Inferno Trigger as soon as you reach S.
TwistedFate.escape: The moment Twisted Fate spends the Gold Card from W Pick a Card is your chance to engage.
TwistedFate.fight: Keep your distance while the Gold Card is ready, and engage when Twisted Fate picks a Blue or Red Card. At close range, alternate Samira Q Flair's sword slash and basic attacks to build Style. Unless a takedown is certain, save Samira E Wild Rush to escape instead of using it to engage.
TwistedFate.laning: Before and after that window, do not force an engage on Twisted Fate while he holds a Gold Card, and dodge Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from behind minions.
TwistedFate.phase: Samira peaks in the mid game. In the late game, enemy defensive items and crowd control mean your allies need to create an opening for you to engage.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Engage after your frontline stops Twisted Fate, and wait for Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's Gold Card to be spent if he still has it. Alternate attack types to reach S, then immediately activate Samira R Inferno Trigger. Hitting several enemies in range lets R heal you more through lifesteal.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card has locked in a Gold Card, one basic attack will stun you, so stay out of his range. Reduce the poke from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards by standing behind minions.

Twitch.build: Twitch's damage relies heavily on basic attacks and attack speed, so prioritize effects that reduce attack speed. One resistance type cannot block all the damage from Twitch E Contaminate, and Twitch P Deadly Venom's true damage is not reduced by resistances, so consider health as well. The available information is not enough to determine the specific first purchase or the order for buying resistances.
Twitch.combo: When your support's crowd control lands, close in with basic attacks and alternate attack types in this order: Samira Q Flair's sword slash → basic attack → Samira E Wild Rush → basic attack → Samira W Blade Whirl. You can hit enemies along Samira E Wild Rush's path by casting Samira Q Flair during the dash. Activate Samira R Inferno Trigger immediately when your Style reaches S.
Twitch.escape: Twitch has no ability to create distance on his own, so once Twitch Q Ambush ends and he reveals himself, dodge Twitch W Venom Cask and close in. Use Samira E Wild Rush to engage only when a takedown is certain or allied support crowd control or Flash is still available. If the takedown is uncertain, save Samira E Wild Rush to escape.
Twitch.fight: Samira can deal her full damage at close range, so engage when Twitch reveals himself and allied crowd control lands. After engaging, alternate basic attacks and Samira Q Flair, among other attacks, to build Style. Unless a takedown is certain, do not use Samira E Wild Rush to engage and lose your escape.
Twitch.laning: Reveal bushes and narrow paths you have no vision of first, and alert your allies when Twitch disappears from lane. Samira has short range, so look for an opening to engage when your support's crowd control lands or your jungler ganks instead of forcing a trade. Do not continue trading inside Twitch W Venom Cask; get out.
Twitch.phase: The mid game, as Samira builds critical strike items, is her peak, so turn allied engages into an advantage. It becomes harder to get into close range late, so fight when your allies create an opening first.
Twitch.teamfight: When Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, spread out sideways from your allies so you do not all take his piercing basic attacks. When Twitch Q Ambush ends and he reveals himself, or when he activates R Spray and Pray and takes position, focus him with allied crowd control. Samira should not engage first; after your allies stop the enemy, build Style to S and activate Samira R Inferno Trigger.
Twitch.watch: Immediately leave the area when Twitch W Venom Cask lands at your feet to reduce Deadly Venom stacks. After taking several basic attacks, back away because Twitch E Contaminate can finish you even at around half health. When Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, its range increases and his basic attacks pierce, so do not line up with your allies.

Varus.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Varus deals primarily physical damage and Samira has relatively low armor, so prioritize armor. Avoid responding by stacking only health, given the damage based on maximum health from Varus W Blighted Quiver.
Varus.combo: When allied crowd control hits Varus, close in with basic attacks and land different attacks in this order: Samira Q Flair → basic attack → Samira E Wild Rush → basic attack → Samira W Blade Whirl. If you need to block Varus's key projectile, save Samira W Blade Whirl for defense and alternate basic attacks, Q, and E. Use Samira R Inferno Trigger immediately when your Style reaches S.
Varus.escape: While Varus aims Q Piercing Arrow, he slows himself, creating a chance to dodge the arrow's path and close in. If Varus R Chain of Corruption is still ready, watch for the root and engage after it is down. Unless a takedown is certain, do not use Samira E Wild Rush to engage and lose your only escape.
Varus.fight: Samira has short range, so wait for a chance to fight up close instead of trading basic attacks from afar. When Varus aims Q Piercing Arrow, sidestep its path and use the opening to close the gap. Varus has no ability to create distance on his own, so when it is safe to engage, close in with Samira E Wild Rush and alternate attack types.
Varus.laning: While being poked from range, do not force trades. Farm under your turret and wait for your support's crowd control or a jungle gank. If an ally lands an immobilizing effect first, close in with basic attacks and fight at close range.
Varus.phase: The mid game, as you build critical strike items, is Samira's power spike, so turn allied engages into an advantage. Her damage stays strong late, but enemy defensive items and crowd control make it harder to get close, so your allies need to create an opening for you.
Varus.teamfight: Samira should not engage first. Close in after your frontline's crowd control stops Varus and build Style. Do not approach an ally rooted by Varus R Chain of Corruption; keep far enough away that the tendrils cannot reach you. If Varus gets a takedown or assist, wait out the few seconds of increased strength. Use Samira R Inferno Trigger once your Style reaches S.
Varus.watch: If Varus hits you with an ability while Blight is stacked from Varus W Blighted Quiver, it triggers damage based on your maximum health. After taking several basic attacks, back off and give the stacks time to expire. Sidestep when you see Varus Q Piercing Arrow being aimed; Samira W Blade Whirl can block the arrow. If an ally is caught by Varus R Chain of Corruption, do not move close; stay far enough away that the tendrils cannot reach you. Varus E Hail of Arrows reduces healing, so do not rely on the lifesteal from Samira R Inferno Trigger while inside its area.

Xayah.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Xayah deals primarily physical damage and Samira has low armor, so prioritize armor. Samira's physical damage is effective against Xayah's low armor.
Xayah.combo: When allied crowd control lands, close in with basic attacks and chain different attacks in this order: Samira Q Flair → basic attack → Samira E Wild Rush → basic attack → Samira W Blade Whirl. If Samira E Wild Rush takes you through a cluster of enemies, cast Samira Q Flair during the dash. Use Samira R Inferno Trigger immediately when your Style reaches S.
Xayah.escape: Dodge out of Xayah E Bladecaller's feather return path to avoid the root, then engage. When Xayah R Featherstorm is still ready, your engage may be wasted, so wait for a sure opening.
Xayah.fight: Xayah's feathers build up if you fight in the same spot for too long, so trade briefly at close range and reposition. When allied crowd control lands, Samira P Daredevil Impulse's basic attack dash gives you a chance to close in. Unless a takedown is certain, do not use Samira E Wild Rush to engage and lose your escape.
Xayah.laning: During a fight, sidestep away from the line between Xayah and her feathers, and keep trades short.
Xayah.phase: The mid game, as Samira builds critical strike items, is her peak, so fight using the advantage you built earlier. Her damage stays strong late, but close-range engages become difficult, so wait for your allies to initiate.
Xayah.teamfight: Samira should not engage first. Close in after your frontline stops the enemy with crowd control. Once you confirm Xayah R Featherstorm is down, engage with Samira E Wild Rush and sidestep Xayah E Bladecaller's feather return path. Hit with different attacks to raise your Style rank to S, then immediately use Samira R Inferno Trigger from a position where it can hit multiple enemies.
Xayah.watch: Xayah E Bladecaller roots you if you are hit by at least three returning feathers. If three or more feathers form a line between you and Xayah, move sideways immediately. Samira W Blade Whirl can block the projectiles from Xayah Q Double Daggers and her basic attacks.

Yasuo.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Yasuo's main damage from Q Steel Tempest and R Last Breath is physical, so prioritize armor. Armor does not block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.combo: When allied crowd control lands, close in with basic attacks and hit different attack types in this order: Samira Q Flair's close-range slash → basic attack → Samira E Wild Rush to get behind him → basic attack → Samira W Blade Whirl. Use Samira R Inferno Trigger immediately when your Style reaches S. If you need to block the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, save Samira W Blade Whirl for defense and build Style with other attacks.
Yasuo.escape: Right after Yasuo fires the tornado from Q Steel Tempest, its stacks reset, creating an opening to engage. Do not engage just because Yasuo E Sweeping Blade is down; close the gap with Samira E Wild Rush alongside allied crowd control before Yasuo R Last Breath is ready again. If the takedown is uncertain, save Samira E Wild Rush to escape.
Yasuo.fight: Use light poke to break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield before committing to a trade. Right after the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest is down, close in at your allies' crowd control and alternate attack types. Unless a takedown is certain, do not use Samira E Wild Rush to engage.
Yasuo.laning: Keep the wave thin and pushed toward your side; this leaves Yasuo fewer minions to dash through with E Sweeping Blade. Either close in briefly to build two or three Style ranks and back away, or all-in when your support's crowd control lands.
Yasuo.phase: The mid game is Samira's peak, so build on the opportunities you created early. In the late game, enemy defenses and crowd control make it difficult to get into close range, so your allies need to create an opening.
Yasuo.teamfight: Do not engage first. Close in after your frontline's crowd control stops Yasuo. If the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest is still ready, dodge sideways or prepare to block it with Samira W Blade Whirl. Alternate attack types to reach S, then immediately use Samira R Inferno Trigger so that multiple enemies are within its range.
Yasuo.watch: After Yasuo Q Steel Tempest hits twice in a row, his next attack becomes a tornado that knocks you up. When its stacks are full, move out of its line and dodge to the side. Samira W Blade Whirl can block an incoming tornado. If Yasuo W Wind Wall is still up, go around the wall or save projectile attacks until it disappears.

Zeri.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Zeri Q Burst Fire and Zeri W Ultrashock Laser deal mainly physical damage, so build armor first. Zeri P Living Battery deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about choosing items that heavily increase health alone.
Zeri.combo: When an ally’s crowd control lands, close in with a basic attack and alternate attack types in this order: Samira Q Flair’s sword slash → basic attack → Samira E Wild Rush → basic attack → Samira W Blade Whirl. As soon as your style rank reaches S, cast Samira R Inferno Trigger. If you can pass through several enemies with Samira E Wild Rush and use Samira Q Flair, press Q during the dash to also attack enemies along its path.
Zeri.escape: The moment after Zeri E Spark Surge is down is your chance to close the distance. If you corner Zeri against a wall, Zeri E Spark Surge’s escape distance increases, so catch her in open terrain. When following up with Samira E Wild Rush, make sure a kill is certain or that you still have a way to get out, such as allied crowd control.
Zeri.fight: Even though Zeri has short range, Samira needs to fight at close range to deal her full damage. Engage after Zeri E Spark Surge is down and an ally’s crowd control lands, alternating basic attacks and abilities to build your style rank. If a kill isn’t certain, don’t use Samira E Wild Rush to engage.
Zeri.laning: Zeri has little kill pressure early and low armor, so look for an advantage before she completes her core items. If there’s no angle to get close, don’t force a trade; farm instead.
Zeri.phase: Samira peaks in the mid game as she builds critical strike items, so pressure Zeri before she completes her core items. In the late game, Zeri’s mobility and the burden of engaging as Samira both increase, so go in when your allies start the fight.
Zeri.teamfight: Don’t engage first as Samira; join after your frontline stops an opponent with crowd control. Alternate basic attacks and abilities to reach S rank, then cast Samira R Inferno Trigger immediately from a position where it can hit several enemies. If Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, don’t chase on foot; wait for a chance to stop her with an immobilizing effect.
Zeri.watch: Zeri W Ultrashock Laser spreads widely when it hits terrain, so don’t stand with your back to a wall or face Zeri in a narrow passage. Once Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, each hit increases Zeri’s movement speed, so don’t chase on foot. When your health is low, also watch out for the execute from Zeri P Living Battery.

Ziggs.build: The available information doesn’t specify a particular first purchase, so one can’t be determined. Against Ziggs’s damage, prioritize magic resistance over armor, and also consider movement speed to walk out of announced blast zones.
Ziggs.combo: When Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down and an ally’s crowd control lands, close in with a basic attack and alternate attack types in this order: Samira Q Flair’s sword slash → basic attack → Samira E Wild Rush → basic attack → Samira W Blade Whirl. Pressing Samira Q Flair during Samira E Wild Rush also lets you attack enemies along the dash path. Cast Samira R Inferno Trigger as soon as your style rank reaches S.
Ziggs.escape: Right after Ziggs uses Ziggs W Satchel Charge, his escape tool is down, so close the distance with Samira E Wild Rush. If Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield remains on your approach path, go around it, and save Samira E Wild Rush for escaping if a kill isn’t certain.
Ziggs.fight: The chance to engage comes after Ziggs uses a full set of abilities, especially right after he uses Ziggs W Satchel Charge. Go around Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield to get into close range, alternating Samira Q Flair’s sword slash and basic attacks to build your style rank. If a kill isn’t certain, consider your escape before using Samira E Wild Rush to engage.
Ziggs.laning: Don’t force trades against Ziggs’s long-range poke; farm under your turret and wait for an opening to engage. Position within basic attack range so you can close in with Samira P Daredevil Impulse when your support’s crowd control or a jungle gank lands. Don’t leave the wave unattended on a lane where the turret has taken heavy damage, as Ziggs W Satchel Charge can demolish it.
Ziggs.phase: In the late game, enemy defensive items and crowd control make it harder to get close, so fight when your allies create an opening to engage.
Ziggs.teamfight: Don’t engage first as Samira; close in after your frontline’s crowd control stops Ziggs. If Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down, approach with Samira E Wild Rush, alternate attack types, and cast Samira R Inferno Trigger as soon as your style rank reaches S. Near objectives, be mindful of Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb flying in from long range and avoid grouping together in one spot.
Ziggs.watch: Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield slows you if you step on it, making follow-up abilities harder to dodge, so move along a path without mines or wait for them to disappear. Watch where Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb lands and dodge, and move away from the center when you see the area of Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb, even if you can’t get fully clear. While Ziggs W Satchel Charge is available, watch out for its knockback and for Ziggs escaping over a wall.
